svg.title: Velvet: Corne Colemak-DH keymap
svg.desc: All eight layers in the existing Velvet physical layout. Top legends are taps; bottom legends are holds. Blank keys have no action, triangles fall through. Encoder controls volume. Scroll and precision use the right two extra bottom keys.

g.text: Colemak-DH · home-row modifiers · Delete held = WM · Caps held = Gaming
